column7: AzureKeyVaultConnector's client had no CheckRedirect override, so it followed a cross-host 301/302/303/307/308 redirect and trusted the redirected response as the secret value (credentials confirmed not to leak, but the response content was); found by response-fuzz harness construction, fixed by hardened_client.go's refuseRedirect wired into azurekv.go's client(); see docs/findings/2026-09-19-FINDING-connect-response-trust-gaps.md §2
